Hi Phil, it's a real treat for us all to be hearing from you on a Friday! As a leftist I don't align with most televised or broadcasted news organizations, instead I come to you. Time after time, you have been collecting data, and telling exactly how it is, without rhetoric tinged language or the yellow journalism that the masses have stopped noticing. Yes there are hard times. Like when we all endured 2020, or when the January 6th riots happened. We all have not stopped fearing for WW3 since Ukraine was attacked by Russia. When your channel leaned further and deeper in to showing us behind the veil biases shrouding political news, you managed to keep your integrity and prioritize values that should be common human decency over becoming a tool for yet another greedy group of politicians. I love you for that man! 

For the people who are feeling "news burnout"... I know it's hard and I know it's hurting you, but that is reality. Imagine the world is an open sea, Imagine your country is a ship with no dock to land on. for it to stay in tip top condition and succeed at taking care of its crew, it's commanding officers must choose it's mission wisely. When command gets us stuck in a storm, you can go to any deck you want, but you will never not feel the ship rock. When command fails to secure supplies for the crew, it does not matter what deck you run to, you simply will not eat. When Command goes into battle with another country ship, you may not be a gunner officer, a member of boarding crew or an escort pilot, but you have just as much a chance to die as everyone else on the ship as holes get blasted into it. so if you are going to cower...then understand, you are one less person who can help patch up a hole on the ship, one less person who can tend to the injured, and one less person who can help petition to relieve a foolish captain! you will not save the day alone, but we cannot save the day without you! backing off is choosing to sit and wait for the crimes to continue until our ship is sunk!
